name: mirage
text: I can't edit bets on your phone: the Tracker lives there, and I only reach the repo and the engine. So I can't enter the results one by one. What I can do is fix why they stay stuck. These bets are over 13 days old, so Novig has no payout row and the score feeds aren't returning a final score for them. I've written this up as task BH1 and will make the grader settle them from the real final scores, so one release clears them all. For now you can tap Won, Lost or Push on a single bet. For Under 6.5 MIL@TB (Oct 28) and Under 226.5 HOU@MIL (Oct 27), look up the final score and tap the result. Tell me if you'd rather I list the real results here for all of them.
